about: Every difference coherence.patch may make to what tree-sitter-typescript 0.23.2 reads, by construct. compare.mjs parses its corpus with the stock and the patched parsers and fails on any region of difference no entry here allows. An entry allows a region when the region is of its kind (improvement: the stock parser errs there and the patched one does not; regression: the other way about; both err: each errs, differently; reshape: neither errs), in one of its dialects, and overlaps a node its query captures as @construct in the tree of its side. Each entry names its cases, one form to a case, and must show in each of them, in each of its dialects, as that case's one region of difference, so none outlives the patch and a form that breaks fails in its own case. A corpus case no entry names, in any corpus, must read exactly as the stock parsers read it: any region of difference in it fails, whatever an entry's query overlaps; an entry's query alone allows a region only in a file (TypeScript's lib, Coherence's src and mods). A case an improvement names is one of Coherence's (corpus/coherence*.txt, outside the patch) and declares the whole tree the patched parsers must read it as. Keyed by construct and case name, never by byte offset, so the corpus may grow. No entry allows a token renamed: a leaf of the patched trees that is no type of its own spelling, or is named and spelled as one of the stock grammar's tokens, must be read as the stock trees read that spelling somewhere in the corpus, inside an improvement's region as anywhere else. An entry's tokens lists such a reading it brings ({text, type, named}), allowed only inside its own regions, and each must show there.
